scripts.features:
This script automatically skips days in the game, giving you infinite money over time.
After using it, make sure to save your game and rejoin to keep your infinite money. HAVE FUN

Game Name:Colony Survival  (Roblox Game)
scripts.script:
--Pls Like And Follow

getgenv().dupe = true

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local eventsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events")
local skipEvent = eventsFolder:WaitForChild("SkipDay")

local function fireSkip()
    skipEvent:FireServer()
end

local function startDupeLoop()
    while getgenv().dupe do
        fireSkip()
        task.wait(0.01)
    end
end

local function initializeDupe()
    task.spawn(function()
        startDupeLoop()
    end)
end

local function verifyEnvironment()
    if typeof(getgenv) ~= "function" then
        getgenv = getrenv
    end
    return true
end

local function verifyReplicatedStorage()
    return ReplicatedStorage ~= nil and skipEvent ~= nil
end

local function startIfReady()
    if verifyEnvironment() and verifyReplicatedStorage() then
        initializeDupe()
    else
        task.spawn(function()
            repeat
                task.wait(0.5)
            until verifyEnvironment() and verifyReplicatedStorage()
            initializeDupe()
        end)
    end
end

startIfReady()

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		local position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		game:GetService('TweenService'):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(dragSpeed), {Position = position}):Play()
	end
	
	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then 
			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragToggle = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if dragToggle then
				updateInput(input)
			end
		end
	end)
